title: Circuit satisfiability and three-CNF satisfiability
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $C$ be a Boolean circuit with $n$ input bits and $g$ gates. The circuit accepts some input if and only if its associated width-three CNF formula has a satisfying assignment of signs on the $n+g$ input and gate coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit with input dimension n
